copper-coast-1.name: Moonta Mines State Heritage Area
copper-coast-1.bio: Cornish copper-mining site at Moonta with the Hughes Enginehouse, a museum and a tourist railway.
copper-coast-1.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=museum node 2158528226 (Moonta Mines Model School Museum, the heritage area's visitor hub); Commons geotag median within 100 m
notes: Area is open to walk; the museum (about $10 adult) and tourist railway ($12 adult) are National Trust attractions inside it, not priced on the spot.
copper-coast-1.ticket_note: No single official page for the heritage area; National Trust museum/railway pages cover only parts of it.

copper-coast-2.name: Moonta Bay
copper-coast-2.bio: Beach, jetty and foreshore at Moonta Bay, with the Rossiters Point lookout nearby.
copper-coast-2.coordinates_source: OSM way 67291089 man_made=pier Moonta Bay Jetty, landward (foreshore) end; no natural=beach feature in OSM
notes: Rossiters Point lookout is OSM node 12164832289 at -34.058268,137.5596485 if a lookout spot is wanted.

copper-coast-3.name: The Farm Shed Museum and Tourism Centre
copper-coast-3.bio: National Trust museum in Kadina with the stump-jump plough, Matta House and a miniature train.
copper-coast-3.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=museum node 2158526679 The Farm Shed National Trust Museum (HIGH, Photon/Nominatim agree)
notes: Adult $12 (child $3, family $30) per the National Trust page; hours Mon-Fri 9-5, weekends 10-4 per that page.

copper-coast-4.name: Wallaroo Heritage and Nautical Museum
copper-coast-4.bio: National Trust museum in Wallaroo's 1865 former post office, covering copper smelting, shipping and local history.
copper-coast-4.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=museum node 450518484 Wallaroo Heritage and Nautical National Trust Museum (HIGH)
notes: Adult $7 from the Yorke Peninsula tourism listing; the National Trust page gives no price (an older directory lists $2.50).

copper-coast-5.name: North Beach
copper-coast-5.bio: Swimming beach on the northern edge of Wallaroo, on the Copper Coast.
copper-coast-5.coordinates_source: OSM way 1491149371 natural=beach North Beach; Wikipedia coordinates within about 100 m (HIGH)

copper-coast-7.name: Splash Town
copper-coast-7.bio: Free water park on the Moonta Bay foreshore, a permanent family stop beside the jetty.
copper-coast-7.coordinates_source: OSM leisure=water_park node Splash Town (MEDIUM); 88 m from Moonta Bay pin
copper-coast-7.ticket_note: Council-run foreshore facility; no verified official page.

copper-coast-8.name: Port Hughes
copper-coast-8.bio: Seaside township and beach on the Copper Coast just south of Moonta Bay.
copper-coast-8.coordinates_source: OSM place=suburb node 33119333 Port Hughes (township point; Wikipedia point is 440 m SSW)

copper-coast-9.name: Copper Coast Rail Trail
copper-coast-9.bio: Sealed 25 km walking and cycling path along the old railway from Kadina through Wallaroo to Moonta.
copper-coast-9.coordinates_source: Midpoint of the route: OSM ways 620994975/1459184170/1051796546 (Kadina to Wallaroo) and 1350389220 Wallaroo - Moonta Trail, 12.5 km along; computed by hand because Overpass was down (MEDIUM)
notes: Renamed from draft 'Copper Rail Trail': Wikipedia and OSM call it Copper Coast Rail Trail.

yorke-peninsula-1.name: Ardrossan Red Cliffs
yorke-peninsula-1.bio: Red clay cliffs above the shore at Ardrossan, best seen from the jetty at sunrise.
yorke-peninsula-1.coordinates_source: OSM way 773025548 natural=cliff at the root of Ardrossan Jetty (MEDIUM)

yorke-peninsula-2.name: Troubridge Island
yorke-peninsula-2.bio: Conservation park island with an 1855 cast-iron lighthouse and keeper's cottage, reached by boat from Edithburgh.
yorke-peninsula-2.coordinates_source: OSM man_made=lighthouse Troubridge Island Lighthouse; Wikipedia point 84 m away (HIGH)
notes: Park entry is free per parks.sa.gov.au; the island is boat-only and needs a permit from Troubridge Island Escape (08 8889 2002). Operator's boat/permit fee not found.

yorke-peninsula-3.name: Edithburgh Tidal Pool
yorke-peninsula-3.bio: Tidal sea-water swimming pool set into the cliff at Edithburgh, with change rooms.
yorke-peninsula-3.coordinates_source: OSM way 1061044346 leisure=swimming_pool Edithburgh Tidal Pool; Photon point within 20 m (HIGH)
yorke-peninsula-3.ticket_note: Open council pool, no verified official page.

yorke-peninsula-4.name: Edithburgh Jetty
yorke-peninsula-4.bio: Jetty where divers and snorkellers find seahorses, Port Jackson sharks and leafy sea dragons.
yorke-peninsula-4.ticket_note: open public jetty, no single steward site

yorke-peninsula-5.name: Corny Point Lighthouse
yorke-peninsula-5.bio: 1882 lighthouse reserve at the peninsula's south-western corner, reached by Lighthouse Road.
yorke-peninsula-5.coordinates_source: OSM man_made=lighthouse + Wikipedia coordinates within 5 m (HIGH)
yorke-peninsula-5.ticket_note: no verified official page; free self-guided reserve

yorke-peninsula-6.name: Yorketown Pink Lakes
yorke-peninsula-6.bio: Salt lakes on the Yorke Peninsula Salt Lake Trail, with a viewing platform at Pink Lake and a boardwalk at Par Lake.
yorke-peninsula-6.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=viewpoint "Pink Lake Viewing Area" (MEDIUM; Pink Lake water body -35.041919,137.590479 agrees within 500 m)
yorke-peninsula-6.ticket_note: no single steward; lakes are open roadside
yorke-peninsula-6.notes: Wiki title is the town article (not this place); consider omitting wiki so photo lookup uses name. Par Lake boardwalk not separately pinned.

yorke-peninsula-7.name: Wool Bay Jetty and Lime Kilns
yorke-peninsula-7.bio: Old port jetty and cliff-top lime kilns with a lookout on the coast road.
yorke-peninsula-7.coordinates_source: OSM man_made=pier "Jetty" at Wool Bay (HIGH per resolve-pin; generic name, locality place node -34.98900,137.75371 is ~700 m away)
yorke-peninsula-7.ticket_note: open heritage stop, no steward site
yorke-peninsula-7.notes: Pin is the jetty; lime kilns sit on the cliff top nearby, not separately resolved in OSM.

yorke-peninsula-8.name: Port Victoria
yorke-peninsula-8.bio: Western-coast town, the last windjammer grain port, with an 1878 jetty, a maritime museum and a coastal geology trail.

yorke-peninsula-9.name: Port Victoria Maritime Museum
yorke-peninsula-9.bio: 1877 cargo shed by the jetty telling the story of the windjammer grain races.
yorke-peninsula-9.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=museum + Wikipedia coordinates (HIGH, ~210 m from the Port Victoria town pin)
yorke-peninsula-9.ticket_note: no official museum website found; only the History Trust SA community-history listing
yorke-peninsula-9.notes: $2.00 per person, family $5.00, child $0.50 from History Trust SA listing (may be dated). National Trust museum; open weekends afternoons per Atlas note.

yorke-peninsula-10.name: Minlaton Harry Butler Red Devil Memorial
yorke-peninsula-10.bio: Free display of the Red Devil monoplane that made the first airmail flight over the sea.
yorke-peninsula-10.coordinates_source: OSM (Nominatim) "Harry Butler Red Devil Memorial" building, Maitland Road Minlaton (MEDIUM)

yorke-peninsula-11.name: Port Vincent
yorke-peninsula-11.bio: Seaside town on the east coast of the Yorke Peninsula with a beach and jetty.

yorke-peninsula-12.name: Point Turton
yorke-peninsula-12.bio: 1876 jetty still used by fishers and white beaches on Hardwicke Bay, with boating and diving.

yorke-peninsula-13.name: Corny Point
yorke-peninsula-13.bio: Surf breaks and three swimming beaches, with a coastal drive from Corny Point to Berry Bay.
yorke-peninsula-13.coordinates_source: OSM natural=beach "Berry Bay" (Nominatim, MEDIUM); town node -34.92633,137.08476 not used so the pin sits on the coast, 1.7 km from the lighthouse
yorke-peninsula-13.ticket_note: coast and town; no single steward

yorke-peninsula-14.name: Black Point
yorke-peninsula-14.bio: Safe white-sand beach with no rips, good for crabbing and swimming, beside Pine Point.

yorke-peninsula-15.name: Sultana Point
yorke-peninsula-15.bio: White-sand swimming beach south of Edithburgh, at the end of the mosaic walking trail.
yorke-peninsula-15.coordinates_source: OSM boundary=administrative "Sultana Point" locality point (Nominatim, MEDIUM; Wikipedia coords -35.11389,137.75944 within 300 m)
yorke-peninsula-15.notes: Locality point, not a surveyed beach feature; verify on map.

yorke-peninsula-16.name: Ardrossan Heritage Museum
yorke-peninsula-16.bio: Museum in the old Smith stump-jump plough factory, with a display on the wreck of the Zanoni.
yorke-peninsula-16.notes: Adult $5 per National Trust listing, Ardrossan town site and History SA directory; one directory (aumuseums) says $1.50, judged outdated. Open daily 10-4 per regional tourism page. No Wikipedia article, wiki omitted.

yorke-peninsula-17.name: Stansbury Museum
yorke-peninsula-17.bio: 1878 schoolroom museum with local history, farm and industry displays, open Wednesday and Sunday afternoons.
yorke-peninsula-17.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage Stansbury listing's own geo tag for the museum (single source; MEDIUM)
yorke-peninsula-17.notes: Adult $3 from the regional tourism listing (older listing $2, others conflict); approximate. Open Wed and Sun 2-4pm, daily in January. No Wikipedia article.

yorke-peninsula-18.name: Edithburgh Museum
yorke-peninsula-18.bio: Community museum in a former produce store tracing the salt industry and local shipwrecks, open weekend afternoons.
yorke-peninsula-18.notes: Adults $3 per Wikivoyage; open Sat and Sun 2-4pm or by appointment. No Wikipedia article.

yorke-peninsula-19.name: Bublacowie Military Museum
yorke-peninsula-19.bio: Private museum and memorial gardens in a former schoolground, with medals, uniforms and military relics.
yorke-peninsula-19.coordinates_source: Wikipedia/Wikivoyage article coordinates for the museum itself (4 dp, MEDIUM; no OSM feature found)
yorke-peninsula-19.notes: Adult $10 per History SA directory (date unknown). Open Sun-Tue 10-4 or by appointment, closed 1 Jul-1 Aug. Private; kept per brief.

innes-national-park-1.name: Cape Spencer Lighthouse
innes-national-park-1.bio: Lighthouse on Cape Spencer, also a clifftop spot for watching southern right whales in winter.

innes-national-park-2.name: Pondalowie Bay
innes-national-park-2.bio: Surf beach and campground at the western end of the park, popular for surfing and fishing.
innes-national-park-2.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=camp_site "Pondalowie Campground" at the bay (MEDIUM; Wikipedia bay point -35.2361,136.8369 is ~210 m away in the bay)

innes-national-park-3.name: Ethel Wreck
innes-national-park-3.bio: Rusting remains of the 1904 shipwreck of the Ethel, lying on Ethel Beach in the park.
innes-national-park-3.coordinates_source: OSM historic=wreck "SS Ethel" + tourism=viewpoint "Ethel Shipwreck" -35.268514,136.845405 within 50 m (HIGH)
innes-national-park-3.notes: wiki omitted: no Wikipedia article titled Ethel (ship).

innes-national-park-4.name: Royston Head
innes-national-park-4.bio: Headland lookout reached by a 4 km return walk of about two hours, with views of the rugged coast.
innes-national-park-4.coordinates_source: Wikipedia article coordinates of the headland (single source; MEDIUM). Commons photo median is 1.7 km away so not used
innes-national-park-4.notes: Hike is pinned at the headland (the lookout feature) not the route midpoint; route not resolved.

innes-national-park-5.name: Stenhouse Bay
innes-national-park-5.bio: Village in the park with the visitor centre, jetty and campground, and winter whale-watching cliffs.
innes-national-park-5.coordinates_source: OSM place=locality "Stenhouse Bay" via Photon (MEDIUM); draft hint -35.2833,136.9333 was Wikipedia's rounded point ~1.5 km off

innes-national-park-6.name: West Cape Headland Hike
innes-national-park-6.bio: Short loop walk to the West Cape lookout, with 360 degree views of the coastline.
innes-national-park-6.coordinates_source: Wikipedia West Cape (South Australia) headland point (LOW: Commons median -35.244899,136.824455 is ~250 m away; route not in resolved OSM)

notes.detail: headland point, not the route midpoint of the ~1 km loop

innes-national-park-7.name: Inneston
innes-national-park-7.bio: Abandoned gypsum-mining township with ruins, interpretive signs and restored heritage cottages.
innes-national-park-7.coordinates_source: Wikipedia Inneston point; Commons median -35.273713,136.891603 (~125 m) and OSM Inneston Historic Walk path -35.27364,136.890877 agree (MEDIUM/HIGH)

innes-national-park-8.name: Stenhouse Bay Lookout Walk
innes-national-park-8.bio: 2 km clifftop loop from the jetty car park, with views over Investigator Strait and the offshore islands.
innes-national-park-8.coordinates_source: OSM man_made=pier "Stenhouse Bay Jetty" as proxy for the Stenhouse Jetty car park trailhead named by the park page (LOW; loop route not found)

notes.detail: trailhead proxy, not the route midpoint

innes-national-park-9.name: Dolphin Beach
innes-national-park-9.bio: Beach in Innes National Park, on the road that passes the Royston Head Hike car park.
innes-national-park-9.coordinates_source: resolve-pin MEDIUM: Median of 3 geotagged Commons photos of Dolphin Beach (File:Dolphin Beach, Dhilba Guuranda-Innes NP 20230209 1-3.jpg) at -35.19401..-35.19422,136.86277; nearest OSM car park n10945729449 is 450 m SE  ""
innes-national-park-9.notes: Entry is the park's AUD 14.40 per vehicle per day fee (parks.sa.gov.au), carried by the 'innes' park pass at apply. Only one guide source plus the agency's passing mention. No Wikipedia article.

innes-national-park-10.name: Marion Bay
innes-national-park-10.bio: Seaside village at the entrance to Innes National Park, with a beach and fishing charters from the bay.
innes-national-park-10.coordinates_source: OSM place=village node Marion Bay (MEDIUM); Wikipedia -35.2419,136.9782 is the rounded locality point, 740 m off
innes-national-park-10.notes: Town outside the park gate, no entry fee. Fishing charters from Marion Bay per regional guide.

innes-national-park-11.name: Gym Beach Hike
innes-national-park-11.bio: 9.8 km return hike through dunes and mallee from Browns Beach to Gym Beach, with orchids and birdlife.
innes-national-park-11.coordinates_source: Midpoint of OSM way 311691505 'Browns Beach to Gym Beach Hike' (4.9 km one way, matches the park page's 9.8 km return) (MEDIUM)
innes-national-park-11.notes: Park lists 4 hours return. Park entry is AUD 14.40 per vehicle (innes pass). Also part of Walk the Yorke. No Wikipedia article.

innes-national-park-12.name: Thomson-Pfitzner Plaster Trail
innes-national-park-12.bio: Hike along the old wooden railway from Inneston to Stenhouse Bay, with signs on local history and environment.
innes-national-park-12.coordinates_source: Point on the OSM path chain of the trail, about midway between Inneston and Stenhouse Bay (way 327015865 'Thomson-Pfitzner Plaster Trail' continues as way 327015851) (MEDIUM, approximate midpoint)
innes-national-park-12.notes: Park lists 3 hours return, 7.6 km. Park entry AUD 14.40 per vehicle (innes pass). No Wikipedia article.

port-broughton.name: Port Broughton
port-broughton.bio: Gulf-side town with an 1876 T-shaped jetty and a base for fishing charters.
port-broughton.coordinates_source: OSM place=village node Port Broughton (MEDIUM); Wikipedia point is the rounded locality centre
port-broughton.notes: Jetty history from the Wikipedia article; fishing charters from Wikivoyage.

port-broughton-heritage-centre.name: Port Broughton Heritage Centre and Museum
port-broughton-heritage-centre.bio: Local history museum in the town's first school building from 1882, with limited afternoon opening.
port-broughton-heritage-centre.coordinates_source: OSM node at the Harvey Street / Edmund Street intersection; History SA places the museum on that corner and Wikivoyage gives 10 Edmund St (MEDIUM)
port-broughton-heritage-centre.ticket_note: No operator site found; only regional tourism and directory listings, so ticketUrl omitted.
port-broughton-heritage-centre.notes: Adult $7 (Wikivoyage, updated May 2024; tourism listing agrees: concession $5, family $15). Hours conflict: Tue and Thu 1-3pm (History SA, Wikivoyage), Tue 2-4pm (SAcommunity 2022), or by appointment. Confirm before applying. No Wikipedia article.

port-wakefield.name: Port Wakefield
port-wakefield.bio: Gateway town at the head of Gulf St Vincent, with a timber wharf and old sandstone buildings.
port-wakefield.notes: 'Port Wakefield' on Wikipedia is a disambiguation page, so wiki is the full title. Wharf, courthouse and sandstone buildings from Wikivoyage.

walk-the-yorke.name: Walk the Yorke
walk-the-yorke.bio: About 500 km of coastal trail around the Yorke Peninsula, from short strolls to long hikes.
walk-the-yorke.coordinates_source: resolve-pin MEDIUM: osm trail midpoint (16.7 km, nominatim) "Walk the Yorke"
walk-the-yorke.notes: Page loaded and titled 'Walk The Yorke' but it is the regional tourism board's, not the council steward's; owner may prefer to drop it. visitHours are for a day section. Entering Innes National Park on it needs the park vehicle fee.

held.name: Wheal Hughes Copper Mine
held.reason: Wheal Hughes Copper Mine: tourists can no longer go underground. Unblocks on a source confirming public access.

entry.name: Wheal Hughes Copper Mine
entry.bio: Former copper mine near Moonta, reopened as a tourist site in 1998 and named for Walter Watson Hughes.
entry.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=attraction node 685207720 Wheal Hughes Copper Mine (MEDIUM)
notes: REVIEW: the draft's bookable 55 m underground tour is not confirmed. Wikipedia says tourists can no longer go underground and a 2008 listing says it closed after a rock fall; other pages still describe tours. Bio written without the tour; confirm public access before adding. Cost recorded as free/open only as a placeholder.

held.name: Investigator Strait Shipwreck Trail
held.reason: No pin found in OpenStreetMap, Wikipedia or Commons; unblocks on the managing body's map or street address.

entry.name: Investigator Strait Shipwreck Trail
entry.bio: Trail of interpretive signs at shipwreck sites along the southern Yorke coast, from Edithburgh to Innes.
entry.coordinates_source: none: sites spread along the coast, no single sourced point
entry.ticket_note: Many sites, no single steward page found.
entry.notes: Spread over many sites (the Ethel wreck is already innes-national-park-3), mainly a dive trail. Regional guide says it highlights 10 of the 26 wrecks between Yorke and Kangaroo Island, 1849-1982. Owner may wish to drop it.
